Mutation matrix: 5 Slice B production changes tested by reverting each in isolation; 3/5 matched a sole killer, 2/5 had legitimate multi-test overlaps (rollback refusal is a matched pair by design; the forward-migration branch removal broke both existing forward-migration tests, not just one). Counted production diff (governance.ignoreList excludes tests/.memory/openspec/AGENTS.md): 474 changed lines, ships with size:exception (pre-accepted 2026-09-14, engram sdd/artifact-retirement/design-decisions) — 8 files: CHANGELOG.md, brain/scripts/hooks/pre-push, brain/scripts/i18n/{en,es}.mjs, brain/scripts/memory/backends/engram.mjs, brain/scripts/memory/cli.mjs, brain/scripts/memory/lib/migrate-v1.mjs, brain/scripts/memory/lib/secret-scrub.mjs. Full apply-progress and mutation matrix table in openspec/changes/artifact-retirement/apply-progress.md and engram sdd/artifact-retirement/apply-progress.
